title: A disturbance observer based approach to current control of PMSM drives for torque ripple reduction
locator: Disturbance-observer current control method; rotor-position-synchronous current ripple and experimental result on 500 W SPMSM
notes: Research reports a disturbance-observer approach that targets current ripple synchronized with rotor position and its harmonics, with an experimental result on a 500 W surface-PMSM. The reported reduction is specific to the experimental motor and setup; it is not a guaranteed outcome or parameter set for CNC torque motors.
